sentences.text: On May 4, 2026, Pottsworth Emergency Department documented that the patient fell from a ladder at a worksite, had right wrist swelling, had an X-ray showing a distal radius fracture, and had a splint applied.
On May 11, 2026, Dr. Tabitha Wrenfield of orthopedics documented that fracture alignment was satisfactory, that the splint was to continue for 3 weeks, and that the patient was not to drive.
On May 25, 2026, Dr. Tabitha Wrenfield of orthopedics documented that the splint was removed and that hand therapy was to begin 2x/week.
On May 26, 2026, Nimblewick Hand Therapy documented at intake that grip strength was reduced and pain was 3/10.
